title: Make the players-choice table-size e2e test reliable on WebKit after Leave table
description: Main CI run 45978923317 (commit 46e6e83, TASK-7.46 merge, no app/bot change) failed once on WebKit: e2e/players-choice.spec.ts:94 'each table size from 2 to 10 starts with that many players and the right advice note' — at :143 after clicking Leave table the 'TLH Trainer' level-1 heading was not visible within 5 s. The failed-job re-run passed. Treat as a timing-sensitive check: find why Leave table sometimes does not reach the main menu within the wait (e.g. a hand in progress opening the leave dialog, or slow session end) and make the test wait on the real condition.
